gse244832.allowed_use: None in the active frozen-query tournament. If a separate nonpromotable diagnostic is approved, fit each RNA-only query representation without ATAC and compare only donor-by-cell-state aggregate predictions against the different-aliquot ATAC assay.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 RNA, ATAC, rows, latent fitting, feature selection, labels, early stopping, projection, or calibration before a separate TaskSpec is approved. RNA and ATAC aliquots are never identity-paired.

gse289173.allowed_use: None. The current model has no frozen RNA encoder, so it cannot enter the one-time sealed cell-state mapping evaluation.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed features, labels, eQTL or ieQTL outcomes, representation fitting, correction-mixture fitting, head fitting, projection, or calibration.

gse296875.allowed_use: None in the active strict tournament. A future diagnostic may train on outer-training same-nucleus pairs and optimize each donor-held representation from RNA alone while held ATAC remains evaluator-only.
gse296875.model_access: Only a future approved diagnostic may let outer-training donors define genes, peaks, decoder, mixture, representations, early stopping, or output scale. Donor-held RNA may affect only its own query-specific latent vector; donor-held ATAC is evaluator-only.

local_model_roster.profile_lane: nonpromotable normalized ATAC softmax profile after RNA-only latent optimization

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; never train as paired rows and never use observed ATAC to fit an RNA query representation
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA-only project seal remains inaccessible because query fitting is not an admitted sealed transform
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact ordered row IDs must be validated before any future paired training, with donor-held ATAC isolated from representation fitting

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, optimized latent vectors, peaks, and seeds are not biological replicates.
rules.feature_contract: Genes, peaks, raw-count recipes, mixture components, decoder architecture, and output profile definition must be frozen inside outer-training donors.
rules.missingness: Missing ATAC remains structurally_missing and is never supplied as an observed zero vector.
rules.profile_rule: The decoder softmax may be called a normalized peak profile. A count mean requires a prospectively frozen target-depth rule and cannot use observed held ATAC depth.
rules.query_fitting_label: Any future result must state that each held RNA profile was used to optimize a new cell parameter. It cannot be compared as frozen representation learning or promoted to a sealed champion.
rules.release_patch_rule: The exact source's _init_test_set naming defect and automatic query-state save must be resolved in a documented project patch before even a diagnostic run; the patch cannot add an encoder or change the scientific identity.
